senses.gloss:
इभ्य a. [इभं गजमर्हति यत्]
1 Wealthy, opulent, rich; Dk. 41.
--2 Belonging to one's servants
(Ved.).
--भ्यः
1 A king.
--2 An
elephant-driver.
--3 An enemy or foe
(Sāy.).
--भ्या
1 A female elephant.
--2 N. of the Olibanum tree,
Boswellia Serrata.
--Comp.
--तिल्वि (व)
ल a. wealthy, rich.
